name: STM Train Pack
description: This pack contains various material for Montréal by updating the basegame vehicles. You will find, Metro on rubber tyres (MPM-10 Azur; Heavy-Metro – MR-73), REM is already in the game as Light Metro, Trains for EXO Commuter (ALP-45DP as bi-mode; Electric Commuter – and Siemens Charger EC-43; Diesel Commuter; both with Multilevel cars), trams (Citadis Spirit; LRT – Flexity Freedom ; Tram) for Montréal Tram plan or Tram de l'Est.
